observations.finding: Setup captures base ref, initializes git if absent, purges later history
Reward resets paths named in test patch, applies patch, executes test_command with verifier timeout unless caller overrides, and rewards only returncode 0

findings.requirement: Translate Python integer unary ~ to Go unary ^ so the supplied program transpiles.

evidence.point: Natural-language contract and concrete expected Go.
Hidden patch only adds test method assert_examples_match("bitwisenot") to test_core.py.
Context upstream helper reads mutable examples/bitwisenot.py and .go from repository, then compares .go to python_to_go(.py).
Runtime reset only protects paths touched by test patch.

findings.hypothesis: If image helper and example files match context upstream, agent can modify examples/bitwisenot.go (or .py) so incorrect transpiler output matches a changed reference, yielding false acceptance. The patch does not restore these reference files.
alternative_explanations: Task image may have a different helper or protect examples by other means.
The image may omit fixture files, in which case the case fails for a different reason.
Out-of-band trainer checks might detect edits despite zero-exit runtime reward.
findings.cheapest_probe: On amd-tw-verification, inspect image fixture/helper and run baseline plus a controlled golden-file mutation under exact runtime; record reward and diff. No code execution on login node.

findings.requirement: Avoid reporting class property this.size in the decorated TypeScript component example.

evidence.point: Issue shows Angular @Input size?: HeadlineSizes and if (this.size).
Added valid test is plain JavaScript class A, with if (this.length) and while (!this.size || foo); no decorator, TypeScript parser, or positive if (this.size) form.

findings.hypothesis: Patch may accept a change that suppresses these two syntactic forms while still flagging the actual Angular TypeScript example; it also assumes all this.length references should be exempt without checking type.
alternative_explanations: The actual rule may be syntax-only and class-member behavior may generalize across JS and TS parsers.
Existing tests in the selected file may cover broader relevant behavior.
Snapshot helper may verify both diagnostics and fixes beyond visible snippet.
findings.cheapest_probe: Inspect task-image test helper/config, then on Slurm add a targeted Angular TypeScript parser case and a plain if (this.size) case; compare baseline, intended fix, and a narrow workaround.
